items.summary: ‘Big Short’ investor Steve Eisman says America’s three biggest wireless carriers are no longer worth owning as Elon Musk’s SpaceX prepares to challenge their dominance. “I think the big three are just uninvestable,” Eisman said on the Nov. 6 episode...

items.title: T-Mobile US (TMUS) Backed A 10% Dividend Increase At Its Parent
items.summary: T-Mobile US (NasdaqGS:TMUS) parent Deutsche Telekom raised its 2026 financial targets for the third time, highlighting higher expectations. Management linked the upgraded guidance to T-Mobile US's adjusted earnings and postpaid account performance, which it cited as key drivers. Deutsche Telekom also announced a planned 10% dividend increase and new share buybacks, citing support from T-Mobile US's contribution. There is more to T-Mobile's role at Deutsche Telekom than this 2026 target hike...

items.title: Verizon Yields 6.2%. Is This Dividend Stock a Trap or a Retirement Bargain?
items.summary: A yield this high usually means Wall Street smells a cut, and Verizon is carrying $166 billion in debt after the Frontier deal. Yet one cash flow number and a bold new strategy from the CEO complicate the bear case for income-hungry retirees.

items.title: Charter Is Cutting $2 Billion in Costs After Losing Another 233,000 Internet Customers
items.summary: Wall Street punished Charter even as it promised billions in savings. The market wants proof that broadband customers are coming back, and the gap between the plan and the quarterly results explains why investors refused to wait.
